entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, agent ID 401. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand GPS tracker right now. This whole process is a joke and I want my money back immediately.
I understand you're frustrated, sir, and I'll do everything I can to help. To pull up your account, could I please get your order number?
It's VF-8675309. And don't waste my time with a runaround. I'm not in the mood.

Thank you for that. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse, which was delivered on January 9th. That was 16 days ago. So I can best assist you, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It doesn't matter what the issue is! I don't want it! Your policy is impossible and I'm telling you, I'm returning it.

I understand your position, sir. However, I do need to inform you of the policy for this specific item. For the VeloBand Pulse, due to its activation process which links the hardware to a user account, we have a strict 10-day return window. As you are on day 16, we are unfortunately outside of that period.

ARE YOU SERIOUS?! TEN DAYS?! That is the most ridiculous thing I have ever heard! I want to speak to your manager right now! This is beyond unacceptable, and you can be sure I'll be posting about this absolutely everywhere!

Sir, I am empowered to handle this call and find a resolution for you. The 10-day policy is firm, but we do have protocols for one-time exceptions in cases of a verified emergency or other extenuating circumstances. Was there a specific reason you were unable to contact us within the first 10 days?

A specific reason? You have no idea. I just got back from an overseas military **deployment** to find out my son had a medical **emergency** and was rushed to the **hospital**! He required immediate **surgery**! The last thing on my mind during all that was your return window.
Oh my, I am incredibly sorry to hear that. Please, I hope your son is recovering well. Thank you for your service, and thank you for sharing that with me. That absolutely qualifies as an exception.
So what does that mean? What are you going to do?

Given the situation, I am absolutely making a one-time exception and overriding the policy for you. I am processing a full refund to your original payment method. I'm emailing you a prepaid return shipping label as we speak. As soon as the tracking shows the item is on its way back to us, the refund will be released.
Oh. A full refund? ...Okay. That's... that's what I wanted. I just got the email. Thank you.
Of course. It is the very least we can do. Again, I wish your son a very speedy recovery. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No. That's all. Thank you, Diana.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
